criteria.statement: Bahia publishes operator-Signet-signed NIP-51 or NIP-78 config events with the required coordinate tags.
Publisher validation rejects malformed list items, non-advancing versions, and secret-looking policy content.
Bahia subscribes to desired and config-status kinds and derives a persisted desired-versus-applied drift view with the last rejection.
Rollback republishes a prior valid desired event's policy or list at the next version without deleting history.
The authenticated web console lists Config Fabric coordinates with desired/applied versions and event IDs, drift, and the latest rejection.
The web detail view renders retained desired/effective configuration, audit statuses, version history, and confirmed rollback.
The web publish editor performs server-equivalent coordinate, monotonic-version, list, policy, secret-reference, and secret-value validation before using the Config Fabric API.
